title: Phase 1: Calendar and Prep
goal: Know the cutoff, the workday schedule, and last month's openings before reconciling anything.
unlocks: The balances and openings the reconciliations read.

title: Phase 2: Reconciliation
goal: Reconcile each account against its outside source and measure its movement.
unlocks: Differences and movements ready for the materiality decision.

title: Phase 3: Adjustments
goal: Book what is material; log what is not.
unlocks: Entries ready for review and passed items ready to total.

title: Phase 4: Review and Sign-off
goal: Get every entry reviewed by someone who did not prepare it.
unlocks: Signed entries the package can certify.

title: Phase 5: Package and Carryforward
goal: Certify, deliver, archive, and roll this month's balances into next month's openings.
unlocks: A certified package and next month's openings.
